sections.section: RULES - Additional Attorney-General The Deputy Attorney General And Standing Counsel (Terms And Conditions) Rules 2011
sections.description:
ADDITIONAL ATTORNEY-GENERAL, THE DEPUTY
ADDITIONAL ATTORNEY-GENERAL,
THE DEPUTY
ATTORNEY GENERAL AND
STANDING COUNSEL
(TERMS AND CONDITIONS)
RULES, 2011
(Substitution of Cl.(a) of R.2)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
22nd January, 2013]
S.R.O.
32(I)/2013, dated 16-1-2013.---In exercise of the powers conferred by
subsection (2) of section 2 of the Central Law Officers Ordinance, 1970 (VII of
1970), the President in pleased to direct that in the Additional Attorney
General, the Deputy Attorney General and Standing Counsel (Terms and
Conditions) Rules, 2011, the further amendments shall be made and shall be
deemed to have been so made on the 1st day of January, 2013, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, for rule 2, for clause (a), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
(a) Additional
Attorney-General.---An Additional Attorney-General shall be entitled to the
following pay, perks and privileges:--
(i)
Salary
Rs.399,445
(ii)
Superior Judicial Allowance
Rs.156,975
(iii)
House Rent allowance
Rs.65,000
(iv)
Vehcile
1300 CC vehicle with three hundred and fifty litres
petrol per month.
(v)
Telephone
Off: No Limit Res" 4.794 p.m. Mobile: Rs.4,000 p.m.
(vi)
Travelling allowance
Rs.2,500 per day".
